cohort_total_n_excerpt: This study included 3313 male participants to the SUpplémentation en VItamines et Minéraux AntioXydants cohort (follow-up: 1994-2007) who completed at least three 24-h dietary records during the first 2 years of follow-up.
reason: The abstract reports associations with total incident prostate cancer only and does not analyze an aggressive incident subtype.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: An inverse association was observed between prostate cancer risk and tertiles of legume intake (hazard ratio (HR)T3v.T1=0·53; 95 % CI 0·34, 0·85; P trend=0·009).
estimate_classifications.reason: This estimate is explicitly for overall prostate cancer risk, not an aggressive subtype.
